messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: PAGER: High 5xx rate detected for 'dedicated-east-1' GPU pool. Triggering enterprise paging. Severity: P1.
Alex Chen: I'm on it, grabbing logs now. Which customers are routing to this pool?
Maya Patel: Aeon Consortium (AC-8421) is on pinned dedicated-east-1 for model: redwood-gpt-large-v1. Also BetaWorks and internal test tenants.
Alex Chen: Noted. Initial symptom: sudden spike in `model-server` 502/503 responses; tail latency unchanged. Could be upstream model-worker OOM or overloaded autoscaler loop.
Jordan Reyes: I see many `broken pipe` + `rpc: deadline exceeded` in the runtime logs. Adding ASGs to scale didn't spin new nodes. Possible autoscaler throttled by API rate limit.
Alex Chen: Trying quick mitigation: pushing fallback route for Aeon only to hosted-backup pool. @Emily Park please prepare customer comms if we need to notify.
Emily Park: On it. Drafting short targeted notice for Aeon (will paste below).
Tony Liu: Running the restart plan: ```bash
# drain and restart model servers to clear stuck kv caches
kubectl -n runtime rollout restart deploy/model-server-dedicated-east-1
# if issues persist, failover routing
rbctl route-modify --customer AC-8421 --from dedicated-east-1 --to hosted-lb-1 --mode gradual
```
Alex Chen: Executed restart. Observability: 30s after restart error rate dropped from 18% -> 6% but still above baseline. Starting gradual failover for Aeon now.
IncidentBot: Action log: `alex` executed `rollout restart` at ts=3478010001. `rbctl` route-modify started at ts=3478010082.
Maya Patel: Can someone confirm contact list for Aeon so CS can notify primary technical contact? I have names but need phone/pager.
Emily Park: Aeon Consortium contact routing (copy from account record):
- Primary technical: Priya Raman (priya.r@aeon-consortium.com) + +1-415-555-0192 (cell)
- Engineering lead: Marcus Lee (marcus.lee@aeon-consortium.com) + +1-415-555-0127 (pager)
- Technical PM: Sofia Gomez (sofia.gomez@aeon-consortium.com)
- Escalation: Enterprise Ops (enterprise-ops@aeon-consortium.com) -> CC legal@aeon-consortium.com for formal notices
Alex Chen: Thanks. Emily can you send targeted note with brief impact + mitigation + ETA? Keep it low-noise for now. Use this template: 
---
Hi Priya / Marcus,

We detected increased 5xx errors impacting generation endpoints for your dedicated deployment in us-east. Impact: 20-60% requests returning 502/503 intermittently since ~09:22 PDT.
What we're doing: restarting model servers and performing a staged failover to our hosted backup pool for your account only. You should see traffic shift over the next ~3-7 minutes.
Current ETA for full mitigation: ~10-20 minutes. We will update you if the ETA changes.
If you observe any outages affecting production traffic after the failover completes, please reply here or call +1-650-555-0300 (Redwood Enterprise Ops).
Apologies for the disruption — we will follow up with a post-incident summary.
Thanks,
Emily (Redwood Customer Success)
---
Emily Park: Sending now to Priya and Marcus. Marking as 'targeted notify' to avoid broad email.
CS-AlertBot: Message sent to priya.r@aeon-consortium.com, marcus.lee@aeon-consortium.com (delivery: success).
Jordan Reyes: After routing ~40% of Aeon traffic to hosted-lb-1 errors dropped to 1.2%. Keeping staged failover until error <0.5% for 5m.
Maya Patel: Can we add a short status page entry? Suggested status: 
- Component: Dedicated GPU Pool (us-east-1)
- Impact: Intermittent 502/503 responses for select dedicated tenants (Aeon Consortium affected)
- Mitigation: Restarted model servers; staged failover applied to Aeon; monitoring
- Next update: in 15 minutes
Alex Chen: Good. Emily, also add a line in the internal comms template for account handoff to Sales/AM: include account id, impact summary, customer contacts, mitigation steps taken, and next steps.
Emily Park: Internal AM note (paste-ready):
---
Account: Aeon Consortium (AC-8421)
Impact: Intermittent 5xx on generation endpoints (20-60% requests) for dedicated-east-1.
Mitigation: model-server restart; staged routing to hosted-lb-1 (observed error drop to 1.2%).
Contacts: Priya Raman (priya.r@aeon-consortium.com), Marcus Lee (marcus.lee@aeon-consortium.com), Sofia Gomez (sofia.gomez@aeon-consortium.com)
Requested follow-up: Post-incident RCA + confirmation of SLA metrics.
Owner: Emily Park (CS) / Alex Chen (SRE)
---
Tony Liu: Monitoring tail: error rate stabilized at ~0.8% after 12 minutes, latency normal. I'll keep autoscaler and runtime team looped for RCA.
Alex Chen: OK keeping this thread open. If error rate climbs back above 2% revert routing and open escalation to infra-oncall.
IncidentBot: :white_check_mark: Incident update recorded. Current severity: P1 -> monitoring.
Emily Park: Sent final short update to Aeon: 'We see errors falling to background levels. If you notice anything please reply.' They acknowledged receipt.
CS-AlertBot: Aeon acknowledged at ts=3478010405.
Alex Chen: Closing paging actions, moving to post-incident work: RCA, ticket to runtime team for autoscaler rate-limit hardening, and customer follow-up. I'll mark this incident for follow-up in 24h.
Maya Patel: Filing RCA ticket now. Link: https://tracker.redwood.internal/INC-8472 (RCA in progress).
Alex Chen: Thanks team. :thumbsup:
